messages:
oncall-bot: Incident created — Elevated 502/504 errors in us-east serving gateway (inbound proxy). Auto-detected by error-rate alerting.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98765 triggered, paging rotation: @sara (SRE primary), escalations set to eng-runtime.
sara: acknowledging, I'm on it. Can someone grab the initial blast radius and number of customers impacted?
alex: support alerts show 12 distinct customers reporting increased 502s since ~09:10 UTC. Error rate peaked ~8% for text-generation endpoints.
mike: I'm seeing a spike in upstream 502s from gateway -> runtime, connection resets and timeouts in the proxy logs. Looks like us-east gateway pool is hitting a backend error path.
jia: any recent deploys or config changes to routing in us-east? I didn't see any automated rollout. infra metrics look stable for nodes.
sara: no deploys on prod in last 6 hours. Running runbook "gateway-502-failures" now.
sara: quick mitigation options: 1) scale gateway replicas in us-east 2) enable cross-region fallback to us-west for specific routes 3) rollback latest kernel flags for proxy if present.
mike: logs: ```
[proxy] 2026-03-14T09:12:33Z upstream response 502 "bad gateway" for /v1/generate (conn reset)
[runtime] 2026-03-14T09:12:34Z model worker OOM? status 503, evicted KV cache
``` 
mike: also seeing many TLS handshake timeouts from clients to gateway.
sara: step 1: scale gateway replicas in us-east to +3 and increase conn pool. Issuing command:
```
kubectl scale deployment/gateway-us-east --replicas=7 -n prod
```
(sara) scaling now.
jia: I'm going to flip the traffic policy for `generation` route to prefer us-west if latency within SLA. Will do gradual shift 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
alex: notifying top customers on the watchlist with potential degraded performance: Acme, CloudDesk, NoteFlow. I'll paste canned blurb after we confirm mitigation.
mike: scaling done, new pods registering. Proxy logs show decreased conn reset but still intermittent 502s. Suggest enabling fallback routing to us-west for the highest-error route.
sara: enabling fallback now: `redwood route update generation --fallback-region us-west --weight 10%`
sara: fallback applied at 10%.
(oncall-bot) Handoff reminder: @sara -> @mike in 30 minutes if still active.
mike: after 10% shift, error rate dropped to ~3.2% in us-east, aggregate errors down to ~2.6% overall. Continuing to ramp.
jia: increasing fallback to 50% now.
alex: support messages queued, sending initial customer notice: "We are investigating elevated 502/timeout errors affecting US-East. Some traffic may be routed to US-West as a mitigation. We'll provide updates." :phone_alert:
sara: rolling increase to 100% fallback for generation route to fully mitigate while we debug root cause.
mike: 100% routing now. Error rate in us-east normalized, generation endpoints stable. Runtime team: still need root cause — there are worker OOMs and a kernel flag mismatch on a subset of runtime instances.
sara: transitioning incident to ENG-RUNTIME for RCA. @mike take lead. I'll update PD and set status: mitigated, customer impact: partial (12 customers reported), estimated 3-4% of requests impacted during peak. Closing timeline: mitigation in place, RCA in progress.
mike: taking over RCA — will correlate heap OOMs with recent memalloc changes and quantization flags. Creating follow-up thread in #eng-runtime.
alex: customer follow-up sent, will collect any error traces they provide.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98765 status: mitigated -> transitioned to follow-up. Next oncall: @jia in 4 hours.
(oncall-bot) Incident closed for page rotation. Hand-off complete. :white_check_mark:
